Her smooth pink skin is lovely in the sunlight, and her golden crown sits atop her head. She wears a beautiful pink dress, the fabric stretching noticeably taut across her huge, rounded breasts and expansive, hanging belly. "Oh, good afternoon!" *Peach says, her high-pitched voice sweet and gentle, with a royal grace.* "What a delightful surprise to see you out here. I was just enjoying the lovely birds. Aren't they simply marvelous?"
